blocks.text: Condo buildings in Canyon Heights
Streets, schools and getting around Canyon Heights

items.t: Canyon Heights is an Upper Capilano neighbourhood in the District of North Vancouver, on the Highland Boulevard corridor, west of Edgemont Village and east of the Capilano River. Exact boundary streets are not verified; the confirmed anchor is the Highland Boulevard corridor, with Canyon Heights Elementary at 4501 Highland Boulevard inside the area. Nearby areas: Edgemont Village (east), Capilano Highlands (north), Forest Hills (north-east), Grouse Woods (north-west) and Queensdale (south-east).

Main streets: Highland Boulevard is the main road, carrying TransLink routes 246 and 232; Capilano Road on the west side carries routes 232 and 236 toward Grouse Mountain and south to Marine Drive and the Lions Gate Bridge; the Upper Levels Highway (Highway 1) is reached via Capilano Road or Edgemont Boulevard.

Transit anchors: route 246 (Downtown / Highland) runs via Marine Drive, Capilano Road, Ridgewood Drive, Edgemont Boulevard, Highland Boulevard and Montroyal Boulevard, with downtown-bound trips crossing the Lions Gate Bridge; route 232 (Grouse Mountain / Phibbs Exchange) runs via Highland Boulevard, Edgemont Boulevard and Capilano Road; route 236 runs on Capilano Road. There is no rapid transit and no condo node inside Canyon Heights.

blocks.text: Good to know about Canyon Heights

items.t: The boulevard changes neighbourhoods mid-corridor. Highland Boulevard carries both Canyon Heights and Edgemont addresses: the verified condo stock on Connaught Crescent and the "EIGHT" duplex project at 3206 Highland Boulevard are Edgemont, while the Canyon Heights stretch west of the village is detached houses only — a "Highland Boulevard condo" search result is almost never in Canyon Heights.

The flood data runs to 2100. The District's GeoWeb flood construction level data is modelled to a 2100 (2080s) horizon plus 0.6 m — a long-horizon number that can surprise a buyer pricing a river-side renovation off today's water levels.

Murdo Frazer's courts were restated in 2025. The Edgemont-area District park east of Canyon Heights carries 6 tennis courts and 6 pickleball courts in the District's Outdoor Sports Courts Optimization Strategy, approved July 21, 2025 — the shared amenity base for a neighbourhood with no strata amenity rooms.
French Immersion is not catchment-locked here.

No project is coming to change the count. No approved major project or presale specific to Canyon Heights is confirmed on a District source — the zero-condo finding in is the current state, not a gap a named pipeline is about to fill.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Canyon Heights
Streets, schools and getting around Canyon Heights

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: nowhere inside Canyon Heights. The District's attached stock concentrates in its centres — Lynn Valley Town Centre, Lions Gate Village and Edgemont Village — all outside Canyon Heights, with Edgemont the immediate neighbour to the east.

Main streets and transit: Highland Boulevard is the main road, carrying TransLink routes 246 and 232; Capilano Road on the west side carries routes 232 and 236 toward Grouse Mountain and south to Marine Drive and the Lions Gate Bridge; the Upper Levels Highway (Highway 1) is reached via Capilano Road or Edgemont Boulevard. Route 246 (Downtown / Highland) runs via Marine Drive, Capilano Road, Ridgewood Drive, Edgemont Boulevard, Highland Boulevard and Montroyal Boulevard, with downtown-bound trips crossing the Lions Gate Bridge; the SeaBus at Lonsdale Quay crosses to Waterfront Station in 12 minutes, every 15 minutes during the day. There is no rapid transit and no townhouse node inside Canyon Heights.

Highlands Elementary, 3150 Colwood Drive, and Cleveland Elementary, 1255 Eldon Road, sit beside the area, and Handsworth Secondary is at 1033 Handsworth Road. SD44 has elementary (K–7) and secondary (8–12) schools only, with no middle tier, and catchments are address-based.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Canyon Heights

items.t: Form B diligence (strata purchases in the neighbouring centres): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.
Fee-simple homes (the stock that does exist here): Canyon Heights is in the District of North Vancouver, not the City of North Vancouver — the City's OCP 8400 / Zoning 6700 do not apply here.

District zoning and plan: District of North Vancouver Official Community Plan, Bylaw 7900 (including its Schedule B Development Permit Areas), and Zoning Bylaw 3210 — Section 525 (Bylaw 8799) sets the R1 minimum lot at 4,000 m² / 30 m width / 34 m depth and standard R2 at 660 m² / 18 m / 34 m, with modifiers R2(S1) at 335 m² / 10 m, R2(S2) at 1,100 m² / 24 m and R2(S3) at 4,000 m² / 30 m; an R2 principal building may include a secondary suite, and a coach house is a dwelling unit accessory to and detached from the principal dwelling unit. A Canyon Heights-specific plan is not verified (none confirmed).

SSMUH/suites as the District states them: since June 2024, a principal dwelling, a secondary suite and a coach house (three units total) are permitted on single-family zoned properties within the Urban Containment Boundary; the District's GEOweb SSMUH classification shows non-exempt lots potentially allowing up to 3 units at 280 m² or less, up to 4 units above 280 m², and up to 6 units above 280 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit bus stop — a per-lot classification, not a street-wide entitlement.

blocks.text: Good to know about Canyon Heights

items.t: The library is on the same boulevard, in the next neighbourhood. The Capilano Library, 3045 Highland Boulevard, is described by the North Vancouver District Public Library as "located in the heart of Edgemont Village" — east of Canyon Heights on the same street its townhouse searches run on, and the Delbrook Community Recreation Centre, 851 West Queens Road, south-east of the area, is the nearest full-service NVRC centre.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Canyon Heights
Fee-simple lots

items.t: R1 / R2 lot fabric: detached houses under Zoning Bylaw 3210, Section 525 (Bylaw 8799), on the Highland Boulevard plateau between the Capilano River and the Mosquito/Mackay creek ravines. Section 525 states the R1 zone minimum lot is 4,000 m² with 30 m width and 34 m depth, and standard R2 is 660 m² with 18 m width and 34 m depth, with modifiers R2(S1) at 335 m² / 10 m, R2(S2) at 1,100 m² / 24 m and R2(S3) at 4,000 m² / 30 m. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size — the zone for a specific lot is confirmed through the District's GeoWeb. A fee-simple lot carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees.

Suites as lot value: an R2 principal building may include a secondary suite, and a coach house is a dwelling unit accessory to and detached from the principal dwelling unit; since June 2024, District zoning permits a principal dwelling, a secondary suite and a coach house — three units total — on all single-family zoned properties within the Urban Containment Boundary. A suite or coach house is part of the house lot's ownership, not a separately saleable lot.
Bare-land strata: none verified

Serviced position, as the District states it: District single-family utility fees in 2026 include water at $932.80 and sewer/drainage at $1,255.60, with combined single-family utilities of $2,571 in 2026 — Canyon Heights' established lots sit inside that District serviced system on that wording. Septic or well servicing is not verified (Not verified item 10) — no well/septic claim is made, and a specific lot's services are confirmed with the District.
ALR vs non-ALR: parcel-level ALR status is not verified; no ALR split is stated for Canyon Heights and none is invented. Check the parcel on ALC mapping before applying any ALR rule.

Hazard-shaped land: District OCP Bylaw 7900, Schedule B sets seven Development Permit Areas, including Protection of the Natural Environment, Streamside Protection, Wildfire Hazard, Creek Hazard and Slope Hazard — a Canyon Heights property can fall in one of these areas along the Capilano River side and on steeper ground, and the District publishes property-level GeoWeb reports, including modelled flood construction levels for a 2100 (2080s) horizon plus 0.6 m. Gross lot area is not buildable area here.

items.t: Municipality: District of North Vancouver, BC — Canyon Heights is an Upper Capilano neighbourhood on the Highland Boulevard corridor, west of Edgemont Village and east of the Capilano River.
Exact boundary streets are not verified.
Nearby areas: Edgemont Village (east), Capilano Highlands (north), Forest Hills (north-east), Grouse Woods (north-west, across the Capilano River side) and Queensdale (south-east).

Roads and transit: Highland Boulevard is the main road, carrying TransLink routes 246 and 232; Capilano Road on the west side carries routes 232 and 236 toward Grouse Mountain and south to Marine Drive and the Lions Gate Bridge; the Upper Levels Highway (Highway 1) is reached via Capilano Road or Edgemont Boulevard. Route 246 (Downtown / Highland) runs via Marine Drive, Capilano Road, Ridgewood Drive, Edgemont Boulevard, Highland Boulevard and Montroyal Boulevard, with downtown-bound trips crossing the Lions Gate Bridge. Commute times in minutes: Not verified.

Schools: SD44 catchments are address-based, with no middle tier (K–7 elementary, 8–12 secondary). Highlands Elementary, 3150 Colwood Drive, and Cleveland Elementary, 1255 Eldon Road, sit beside the area; catchments for all other Canyon Heights addresses are address-specific and not verified here — confirm each with SD44.

Parks and services: Capilano River Regional Park (Metro Vancouver), on the Capilano River west of the area, offers the Capilano Pacific Trail and the Coho Loop Trail; Mosquito Creek and Mackay Creek run through the Upper Capilano ravines east of the area. The Delbrook Community Recreation Centre, 851 West Queens Road, south-east of the area, is the nearest NVRC full-service centre; the Capilano Library, 3045 Highland Boulevard, is in Edgemont Village, east of the area. No shopping centre or grocery store in Canyon Heights is confirmed on a District source — not verified; the District's OCP names Edgemont, immediately east, as one of its six Village Centres. Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver, serves the North Shore.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Canyon Heights

items.t: OCP + zoning (District only): District of North Vancouver Official Community Plan, Bylaw 7900 (including its Schedule B Development Permit Areas), and Zoning Bylaw 3210, Section 525 (R1/R2 minimums in Sections 1–2). A Canyon Heights-specific plan is not verified (none confirmed). The City of North Vancouver's OCP 8400 / Zoning 6700 belong to the city only and are never imported here.

SSMUH / added units, as the District and Province state them: three units total (principal, secondary suite, coach house) are permitted on single-family zoned lots within the Urban Containment Boundary since June 2024. The District's GEOweb SSMUH classification shows non-exempt lots potentially allowing up to 3 units at 280 m² or less, up to 4 units above 280 m², and up to 6 units above 280 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit bus stop; provincial rules set 3 units on lots of 280 m² or smaller, 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on larger lots within 400 m of a prescribed bus stop. Verify the parcel's classification before pricing in unit potential.

Subdivision + servicing requirements — servicing-bylaw number held not confirmed: subdivision runs against the Section 525 zone minimum lot area, width and depth for the lot's R1/R2 zone, confirmed through the District's GeoWeb. The process documented instead: confirm the zone and GeoWeb property report (including hazard layers and the modelled flood construction level) for the parcel, then confirm servicing and any off-site works with the District before subjects.

Hazard development permits: OCP Bylaw 7900, Schedule B sets seven Development Permit Areas, including Protection of the Natural Environment, Streamside Protection, Wildfire Hazard, Creek Hazard and Slope Hazard — whether a lot is in one is a District GeoWeb map check, and creek, slope and wildfire permit areas can add geotechnical and permit cost to a rebuild on river-side and steep lots.

Strata block (no strata stock is documented in Canyon Heights; stated for any strata lot form): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children). A listing's "45+" line is not a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (no Canyon Heights ALR parcel is confirmed here; standing rules for completeness only): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; residence caps principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); farm class three-tier ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

blocks.text: Good to know about Canyon Heights

items.t: The plateau is split by creeks, not just streets: Mosquito Creek and Mackay Creek run through the Upper Capilano ravines east of the area — District planning material describes Mosquito Creek as a "creekside natural area with well used trails" and MacKay Creek as a "creekside natural area with fish habitat" — so two lots on the same street can sit in different permit regimes.

The flood number is modelled to 2100, plus 0.6 m: the District's GeoWeb flood construction levels are modelled for a 2100 (2080s) horizon plus 0.6 m — a rebuild priced off today's water level alone is priced off the wrong document.

The retail is in the next neighbourhood, by plan: the District's OCP names Edgemont, immediately east, as one of its six Village Centres (with Lions Gate, Queensdale, Maplewood, Parkgate and Deep Cove) — Canyon Heights itself has no confirmed shopping centre or grocery store on a District source, and that is the plan working as written, not a gap about to be filled.

A direct downtown bus runs off the plateau: route 246 runs from Highland Boulevard via Edgemont and Capilano Road directly downtown over the Lions Gate Bridge, and route 232 links the area to Grouse Mountain and Phibbs Exchange — the car-light case for these lots rests on those two routes, not on a station.

No market figure exists to quote for this plateau: North Vancouver is outside SnapStats coverage entirely, so any Canyon Heights median, ratio or trend figure attributed to SnapStats anywhere should be treated as an error.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Canyon Heights
What a duplex looks like in Canyon Heights

items.t: The usual duplex form: Canyon Heights' realistic smaller-form purchase is not a duplex complex at all — since June 2024, District zoning permits a principal dwelling, a secondary suite and a coach house (three units total) on all single-family zoned properties within the Urban Containment Boundary, on one lot's title. The standing duplex form class is individual duplex buildings on single lots built under the zoning of their day inside the District's detached-residential frame. A specific duplex is verified on its title (one lot, strata plan, or subdivided pair).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Canyon Heights

items.t: Since June 2024, District zoning permits a principal dwelling, a secondary suite and a coach house — three units total — on all single-family zoned properties within the Urban Containment Boundary. A suite or coach house is part of the house lot's ownership — it cannot be bought separately. The District's GEOweb SSMUH classification shows non-exempt lots potentially allowing up to 3 units at 280 m² or less, up to 4 units above 280 m², and up to 6 units above 280 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop. SSMUH adds unit potential on one title; it does not by itself split a duplex into separately titled halves.
